verdict.rationale: BVNK exposes a conventional REST API (e.g. POST /payment/v1/rules, /payment/v2/payins/simulation) and hides chain mechanics: it generates unique or reusable blockchain addresses per payment or channel and manages conversion and settlement, so developers never run nodes. However, the evidence shows no client libraries or SDKs, and developers must hand-generate Hawk signatures for each request, which adds integration friction. Missing for 10: documented client libraries/SDKs in common languages, explicit gas/fee abstraction evidence, independent hands-on corroboration.
